<script type="text/javascript">
            function debuglog(msg) {
                if (typeof console != "undefined") {
                    console.log(msg);
                }
            }

            function getquerystring(name) {
                if (name = (new RegExp('[?&]' + encodeURIComponent(name) + '=([^&]*)')).exec(location.search)) {
                    return decodeURIComponent(name[1]);
                }

                return "";
            }

            function initSearch(fieldid) {
                jQuery("#" + fieldid).attr("placeholder", "Loading...");
                var oldval = $("#" + fieldid).val();
                $("#" + fieldid).val("");
                $("#" + fieldid).attr("readonly","true");

                var searchJsonUrl = myDomainRoot + "SearchJSON.aspx";

                if (jQuery("#" + fieldid).attr("onlyonline") == "1") {
                    searchJsonUrl = "/SearchJSONOnline.aspx";
                }

                debuglog("Loading SearchData " + searchJsonUrl);

                jQuery.get(searchJsonUrl, function (data) {
                    debuglog("Got Search JSON with " + data.girls.length + " girls");

                    jQuery("#" + fieldid).attr("placeholder", "Suche");

                    var grlsnames = [];
                    var grlsnamesmap = [];

                    jQuery(data.girls).each(function () {
                        grlsnames.push(this.name);
                        grlsnamesmap[this.name] = this;
                    })
                    var $input = $("#" + fieldid);
                    console.log(data.girls);
                    $input.typeahead({
                        source: grlsnames,
                        autoSelect: true
                    });
                    $("#" + fieldid).val(oldval);
                    $("#" + fieldid).removeAttr("readonly");

                    $("#" + fieldid).focus();

                    $input.change(function () {
                        var current = $input.typeahead("getActive");
                        if (current) {
                            // Some item from your model is active!
                            if (new String(current).trim().toLowerCase() == new String($input.val()).trim().toLowerCase()) {
                                // This means the exact match is found. Use toLowerCase() if you want case insensitive match.
                                debuglog("exact match in search");
                                var targetname = new String(current);
                                targetname = targetname.replace(new RegExp("[+]", "g"), "--");
                                if ($input.attr("targetpage") == "LiveChatProxy") {
                                    document.location.href = "/LiveChatProxy.aspx?Pseudo=" + encodeURIComponent(targetname);
                                } else {
                                    document.location.href = "/de/girl/" + encodeURIComponent(targetname);
                                }
                            } else {
                                // This means it is only a partial match, you can either add a new item 
                                // or take the active if you don't want new items
                                debuglog("partial match in search");
                            }
                        } else {
                            debuglog("no match in search");
                        }
                    });
                }, 'json');
            }
        </script>

        }

    function checkCamsCatNav() {

        jQuery("#grpCategoryMoreMenu").children().each(function (index) {
            if (jQuery(this).hasClass("fixmore")) {

            firsttop = myoff.top;

        var lastitem2 = null;

        jQuery("#grpCategory").children().each(function (index) {
            if (new String(jQuery(this).prop("tagName")).toLowerCase() == "a") {
                myoff = jQuery(this).offset();
                if (myoff) {
                    if (myoff.top > firsttop) {
                        jQuery("#grpCategoryMoreMenu").append("<a class='dropdown-item' href='" + jQuery(this).attr("href") + "'>" + jQuery(this).html() + "</a>");
                        jQuery(this).addClass("overflow");
                        debuglog("added " + jQuery(this).html() + " -> " + jQuery(this).attr("href"));
                    } else {
                        lastitem2 = lastitem;
                        lastitem = jQuery(this);
                    }
                };
            }
        });

        myoff = jQuery("#grpCategoryMoreDIV").offset();
        if (myoff) {
            if (myoff.top > firsttop) {
                if (lastitem != null) {
                    jQuery("#grpCategoryMoreMenu").append("<a class='dropdown-item' href='" + jQuery(lastitem).attr("href") + "'>" + jQuery(lastitem).html() + "</a>");
                    jQuery(lastitem).addClass("overflow");
                    debuglog("added " + jQuery(lastitem).html() + " -> " + jQuery(lastitem).attr("href"));
                }
                if (lastitem2 != null) {
                    jQuery("#grpCategoryMoreMenu").append("<a class='dropdown-item' href='" + jQuery(lastitem2).attr("href") + "'>" + jQuery(lastitem2).html() + "</a>");
                    jQuery(lastitem2).addClass("overflow");
                    debuglog("added " + jQuery(lastitem2).html() + " -> " + jQuery(lastitem2).attr("href"));
                }
            }
        }

        // fixmore items ans Ende
        jQuery("#grpCategoryMoreMenu").children().each(function (index) {
            if (jQuery(this).hasClass("fixmore")) {
                jQuery("#grpCategoryMoreMenu").append("<a class='fixmore dropdown-item' href='" + jQuery(this).attr("href") + "'>" + jQuery(this).html() + "</a>");
                jQuery(this).addClass("overflow");
            }
        });

        jQuery(".overflow").detach();
        jQuery(".overflow").remove();
            
        markActiveCatButton();
    }

    function markActiveCatButton() {
        debuglog("markActiveCatButton | mycamcat: " + mycamcat);

        if (mycamcat != "") {
            jQuery("#grpCategory").children().each(function (index) {
                var mylink = new String(jQuery(this).attr("href"));
                debuglog("mylink: " + mylink + " | mycamcat: " + mycamcat);

                if (mylink.indexOf("cams/" + mycamcat) >= 0) {
                    jQuery(this).addClass("active");
                }
            });

            jQuery("#grpCategoryMoreMenu").children().each(function (index) {
                var mylink = new String(jQuery(this).attr("href"));
                debuglog("mylink: " + mylink + " | mycamcat: " + mycamcat);
                if (mylink.indexOf("cams") >= 0 && mylink.indexOf(mycamcat) >= 0) {
                    jQuery(this).addClass("bold");
                }
            });
        }

function doesArrayContainStringMainCams(myarray, mystring) {
    for (var i = 0; i < myarray.length; i++) {
        if (new String(myarray[i]).toLowerCase() == new String(mystring).toLowerCase()) {
            return true;
        }
    }

    return false;
}

function addParamToURL(url, param, value) {
    if (value != "") {
        return url + "&" + param + "=" + encodeURIComponent(value);
    } else {
        return url;
    }
}

<script type="text/javascript">
            var lastWindowWidth = 0;
            var lastWindowHeight = 0;

            function viewportfunc() {
                var e = window, a = 'inner';
                if (!('innerWidth' in window )) {
                    a = 'client';
                    e = document.documentElement || document.body;
                }
                return { width : e[ a+'Width' ] , height : e[ a+'Height' ] };
            }

            function setWindowWidth() {
                var newwidth = 0;
                var newheight = 0;

                if(viewportfunc().width > 0) {
                    newwidth = viewportfunc().width;
                } else {
                    newwidth = jQuery(window).width();
                }

                if(viewportfunc().height > 0) {
                    newheight = viewportfunc().height;
                } else {
                    newheight = jQuery(window).height();
                }

                if(newwidth != lastWindowWidth || newheight != lastWindowHeight) {
                    debuglog("Setting windowWidth: " + newwidth + "x" + newheight);
                    var jsonurl = "/json.aspx?windowWidth=" + newwidth + "&windowHeight=" + newheight;
                    jQuery.getJSON(jsonurl,function(data) {
                        debuglog("windowWidth has been set: " + data.success + " | sessionCounted: " + data.sessionCounted + " | sessionCountedThisTime: " + data.sessionCountedThisTime);
                    });
                }
            }

            jQuery(document).ready(function () {
                setWindowWidth();
                setTimeout("setWindowWidth()", 3000);
            });

            jQuery(window).resize(function () {
                setWindowWidth();
            });
        </script>

<script type="text/javascript">
            function doDeferredImages() {
                clearInterval(delayImagesIntervalID);
                delayImagesTimer = false;

                var windowHeight = jQuery(window).height();
                var myScrollTop = jQuery(window).scrollTop();

                jQuery("img").each(function () {
                    var mydatasrc = jQuery(this).attr("data-src");

                    if (typeof mydatasrc !== typeof undefined && mydatasrc !== false) {
                        var myoff = jQuery(this).offset();

                        debuglog(mydatasrc + " | " + (myScrollTop + windowHeight) + " | " + myoff.top);

                        if ((myScrollTop + windowHeight) >= myoff.top) {
                            jQuery(this).attr("src", jQuery(this).attr("data-src"));
                        }
                    }
                });
            }

            var delayImagesIntervalID;
            var delayImagesTimer = false;

            jQuery(document).ready(function () {
                doDeferredImages();
            });

            jQuery(window).load(function () {
                doDeferredImages();
            });

            jQuery(window).scroll(function () {
                if (!delayImagesTimer) {
                    delayImagesIntervalID = setTimeout("doDeferredImages()", 250);
                    delayImagesTimer = true;
                }
            });
        </script>
